attn.title: Causal attention of block 0 (batch 2, 16 characters)
attn.code:
def attention(p, x, n_heads):                     # x [B, T, D]
    B, T, D = x.shape
    dh = D // n_heads
    split = lambda t: t.reshape(B, T, n_heads, dh).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    q, k, v = (split(linear(p[n], x)) for n in ("wq", "wk", "wv"))
    s = q @ k.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2) / math.sqrt(dh)
    mask = jnp.tril(jnp.ones((T, T), bool))
    s = jnp.where(mask, s, -jnp.inf)
    a = jax.nn.softmax(s, axis=-1) @ v
    return linear(p["wo"], a.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, T, D))
attn.note: jnp.tril and jnp.where appear as nested jit (pjit) equations with their own sub-jaxpr; softmax's max is under stop_gradient.

cf.title: cond, scan and while_loop, with a closed-over NumPy constant
cf.code:
big_np = np.arange(16.0, dtype=np.float32)

def cf(x, n):                           # n is static
    y = jax.lax.cond(x.sum() > 0, lambda v: jnp.sin(v), lambda v: v * 2.0, x)
    z, _ = jax.lax.scan(lambda c, t: (c * 0.5 + t, None), y, jnp.ones((3, 16)))
    w = jax.lax.while_loop(lambda s: s[0] < n, lambda s: (s[0] + 1, s[1] * 0.9), (0, z))[1]
    return w + big_np + 3.0

jax.make_jaxpr(cf, static_argnums=1)(jnp.ones(16), 4)
cf.note: The NumPy array became a constvar (before the semicolon); scalars became literals. cond lists its branches false first (index 0). The static n = 4 is a literal inside while's cond_jaxpr.
